newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-VIERI SAYS JUVE SHOULD SELL HIM.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-VIERI SAYS JUVE SHOULD SELL HIM.

text.p: Italian striker Christian Vieri thinks serie A side Juventus would miss a great opportunity if they refused to sell him to Spanish club Atletico Madrid for next season.

"Thirty five billion lire ($21.9 milliom) is an enormous fee. If I were in the shoes of my managers I wouldn't have to think about it too long: I'd let Vieri go," the 23-year-old striker was quoted as saying in Turin newspaper Tuttosport.
Juventus have said repeatedly that Vieri will not go on the transfer market despite vice-president Roberto Bettega's comment earlier this month that every player had his price.
